description:
Cast the copy of Stream of Life from exile for X=4 by paying {4}{G}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Resolve the Molten-Core Maestro trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding the one non-red mana you need to cast the spell from step 1.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.
